about_the_game:
In a world where dreams are sold as entertainment, it's your job to ensure that each is market-ready. Step into virtual dreamscapes as a newly-recruited maintenance worker and immerse yourself in serene yet fractured landscapes as you perform your inspection.

Some memories don’t fade—they hide. As you navigate the minds behind the dreams, cryptic messages and lingering voices pull you deeper into a psychological mystery where the truth is waiting to be untangled. Sharpen your senses and dive into an unforgettable story.

Tread carefully however, as every decision shapes the story and the dreamscapes around you. Listen closely to the characters that you encounter on your journey, as some may know more than they let on. Will you choose wisely and uncover the hidden truths or let them slip away?

ONEiRA is a narrative-driven puzzle-platformer that blends immersive storytelling with unique mechanics. Collect exciting abilities that help you solve puzzles, traverse obstacles, and explore the ever-shifting dreamscapes. Get ready to suit up and wishlist ONEiRA now!

Note: ONEiRA is a work in progress, and the images shown may not reflect the final game

content_descriptors.notes:
ONEiRA explores complex emotional and psychological themes through a surreal and symbolic narrative. The game includes depictions of the following content: Psychological distress and internal conflict, themes of grief, trauma, and loss, symbolic portrayals of violence and emotional manipulation.

While the game does not contain explicit depictions of sexual acts, players may encounter narrative elements involving power struggles and emotionally intense scenes that reflect on identity, morality, and fractured memory. These themes are presented thoughtfully and with a narrative purpose but may not be suitable for all audiences.

Player discretion is advised.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad-Core Processor or greater
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB Dedicated Video Card (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD equivalent)
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Linux-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: Not supported (at this time)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 or better
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Linux-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: Not supported (at this time)
  • Additional Notes: A SSD is recommended.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad-Core Intel Core i5 or Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB Dedicated GPU (e.g., Radeon Pro 5500M or M1 integrated GPU with 8-core)
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible audio output device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS version 10.15.4 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (3.6 GHz) or Apple M1 Pro/Max
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5700 XT (8 GB) or Apple M1 Pro/Max integrated GPU
  • Sound Card: Mac-compatible audio output device
  • Additional Notes: A SSD is recommended.
